Preserve shell state when running checks without selected tests

findings.body:
Gain 5, Work 3, Harm 3
Raise: Functional. Case: normal use - a pull request runs the generated single-job tests workflow. [Actions checkout uses detached HEAD for pull requests](https://github.com/actions/checkout#push-a-commit-to-a-pr-using-the-built-in-token). Consequently, review.test_run gets an empty branch and item (review.py:435-436). Its record_run calls record_event, which passes that empty item to read_state (repo.py:449-450); state_path rejects it (repo.py:985-986). The new CI command therefore fails before executing any tests or checks. Handle the detached checkout in the command and exercise the generated step in that state; the current selection test uses a named worktree.
findings.title: Support detached HEAD before invoking change tests in CI

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional. Case: normal use - a Python client uses `cd backend && python lint.py && pytest tests`, and a changed module selects no tests. Each retained part now runs in a separate shell, so `cd backend` has no effect on the following lint command. Forge runs lint from the repository root and fails to find backend/lint.py. Environment setup through `export`, activation scripts or Windows `set` is likewise discarded. Execute the retained checks as one ordered shell chain so the no-selection path preserves the configured command's setup.
findings.title: Preserve shell state when running checks without selected tests

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 1, Harm 3
Raise: Functional. Case: normal use - Forge's retained six-group CI runs its test suite. This change removes `runs the full suite` from both the shipped skill and docs/guide.md, but tests/test_fix_close_runs_fast_test_instead_of_test.py:87 still requires that exact phrase in each file. Therefore test_6_the_skill_and_the_guide_recommend_fast_test deterministically fails. Update that assertion to protect the new related-test contract and the preserved pytest-split exception.
